verifications.claim: Ezekiel 25:17 is a biblical verse focused on divine vengeance against nations that wronged Israel.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '“And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them,” reads the Bible’s King James Version.' R4: 'Thus I will execute great acts of vengeance on them... against the Philistines... Ammonites... Moab... Edom' who 'jeered at my sanctuary... land of Israel... house of Judah'. R5: 'A Prophecy Against the Philistines... I will execute great vengeance against them'.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources quote the verse on divine vengeance and provide context of judgment against nations (Philistines, Ammon, Moab, Edom) that rejoiced over or wronged Israel/Judah.

verifications.claim: Many translations of Ezekiel 25:17 read "And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them."
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: KJV quote exact. R2: KJV 'And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.' R3: KJV exact. R5: KJV exact; NKJV and others very similar. R6: NKJV nearly exact.
verifications.reasoning: Exact wording matches KJV across sources; similar phrasing in NKJV and others confirms 'many translations' use this or near-identical wording.

verifications.claim: The King James Version (KJV) of Ezekiel 25:17 reads "And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them."
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '“And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them,” reads the Bible’s King James Version.' R2: KJV exact match. R3: KJV '“And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.”'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly attribute and quote the exact text to KJV.

verifications.claim: Ezekiel 25:17 is commonly confused with a fictionalized, violent monologue from the movie Pulp Fiction.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: Hegseth 'quoted almost word-for-word a violent prayer... from “Pulp Fiction”... borrows some wording from Bible verse Ezekiel 25:17, but didn’t mention it was adapted... from a violent monologue'. R3: 'reciting a famous fictionalized Bible quote from "Pulp Fiction"... Jackson's character attributes the passage to Ezekiel 25:17. However, it is a fictionalized version'. R7: 'Ezekiel 25:17 monologue (a fabricated biblical passage)... Pulp Fiction'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe Pulp Fiction's fictionalized version attributed to Ezekiel 25:17, recent confusion by Hegseth, confirming common mix-up.
